args.body: Implemented: greet(name) now capitalizes only the first letter, e.g. greet('zharn') -> 'hello Zharn'. Change: hello.py greet() uses f"hello {name[:1].upper()}{name[1:]}" instead of f"hello {name}" (deliberately not str.capitalize(), which would also lowercase the rest of the name). Tests (test_hello.py): updated existing test_greet to expect 'hello Zharn'; added test_greet_only_capitalizes_first_letter asserting greet('zHARN') == 'hello ZHARN' to pin down that only the first letter changes. TDD followed: wrote both tests first, watched both fail for the expected reason, then made the minimal implementation change; both pass now (python3 -m pytest test_hello.py -v: 2 passed). Committed as bf3d398 on branch zharn/BASE-1.
